Listing highlights
In Historic Nolensville
About a 5-min walk to Nolensville Park, with coffee, restaurants, and shops right down the street
Spacious guesthouse on a big lot
A 1,400 sq ft guesthouse on over an acre with a pool, fire pit, and yard games out back
Quiet and well-located
Guests describe a quiet, convenient location with easy access to everything in Nolensville
This 1,400 sq. ft. darling space is on 1.30 acres right down the street from Historic Nolensville and walking distance to coffee, food, dress shops and more. Want to kick your heels up in Nashville? No problem, only a 25 minute drive or a nice uber ride through some amazing scenery and beautiful homes along the way.  Enjoy the pool, yard games, picnic area, roast some marshmallow's over a nice evening fire with your favorite glass of wine. Dogs are allowed up to 20 lbs with a pet fee. No cats.

Guest access
House, pool deck, and backyard.

Other things to note
This unique property boasts two short-term rentals. You can rent the entire property for family and friends, or you can rent an individual unit. If you choose to rent an individual unit, rest assured that the other areas will be unavailable for other renters. You’ll have exclusive access to your chosen space.

You'll have access to the large backyard where you can enjoy the pool, swing set, picnic tables, yard games, smokeless fire pit, and more. This rental also includes an indoor lounge area that can be used for our Airbnb’s guests.
